summary: Verified QuotePDFTemplate footer/social layout fix on the quote view page. Login OK, quote 6bb51376... loads (GM-202606-0002 in this env, not GM-202609-0001 mentioned in request). Measured #quote-pdf-root bounding box: width=793.69px, height=1122.52px, pxPerMm=3.779, so root height = 297.00mm (exact A4 single page). Green social strip (#70c800 'gastromek.de') sits at top=164.15mm bottom=172.90mm from #quote-pdf-root top — well within page 1 (<297mm). Grand-total green GESAMTBETRAG box: top=136.44mm bottom=149.32mm. Footer .pdf-section is present (2 pdf-sections found: notes/validity + social strip) but the BANK INFO block does NOT render because company settings have empty bank_name/bank_iban and banks:[] (verified via /api/settings). Therefore the original 'clipped bank footer' cannot be visually reproduced in this environment. Structurally the fix is correct: footer div and SocialStrip both carry className='pdf-section', so the page-slicer safe-break selector 'tbody tr, .pdf-section, .pdf-row' will not cut through them. Both PDF downloads succeeded without JS/console errors: 'Angebot-GM-202606-0002-DE.pdf' (normal) and 'Angebot-GM-202606-0002-DE-ohne-Preise.pdf' (priceless). Priceless template (#quote-pdf-root-priceless) is present in DOM with two .pdf-section elements; bank block absent for the same reason (no bank configured).

rca of the issue: Original bug: bank footer clipped and social strip pushed to page 2. Fix applied by main agent (adding pdf-section class to footer and SocialStrip + reduced margins) is structurally sound; page-slicer in QuoteView.generatePdf uses querySelectorAll('tbody tr, .pdf-section, .pdf-row') as safe break points, and now both blocks are marked so cannot be split.
